<thought>To obtain the required mapped reaction and template ID, I will search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template whose forward reaction breaks a carboxylic ester and forms an aldehyde and an aliphatic hydroxyl, which matches the DIBAL‑H reduction described. I will use the product SMILES from the provided precursor list as the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic esters"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aldehydes", "aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
